summary: The victim interacted with a fraudulent cryptocurrency platform and believed 500 USDT had been lost after granting token approvals. After revoking the malicious token approvals and disconnecting the website the funds reappeared in the wallet indicating the scam relied on unauthorized smart contract permissions.
user_mistake: Granted token approvals to an unverified website.
prevention: Review and revoke token approvals immediately / Disconnect suspicious websites from your wallet
